title: Practice 4: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Крольчонок попался в ___ (ловушка, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: A baby rabbit had been caught in a trap.
exercises.why: **ловушка → ловушку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (ликвидация, acc. sg.) аварии брошены все силы.
exercises.prompt: Every effort has been made to deal with the accident.
exercises.why: **ликвидация → ликвидацию** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like армия (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (свободное время, acc. sg.) Том рисует горностаев.
exercises.prompt: Tom draws stoats in his spare time.
exercises.why: **время → время** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like имя (A. sg. имя). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свободный → свободное** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with время). Declines like новый (A. новое). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (всякий случай, acc. sg.) держись за поручень.
exercises.prompt: Get hold of the rail just in case.
exercises.why: **случай → случай** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like трамвай (A. sg. трамвай). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **всякий → всякий** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with случай). Declines like русский (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Оса залетела Тому в ___ (рот, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: A wasp flew into Tom's mouth.
exercises.why: **рот → рот** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я не знаю, что состряпать на ___ (ужин, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I don't know what to make for dinner.
exercises.why: **ужин → ужин** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Поле, на котором мы раньше играли в ___ (мяч, acc. sg.), сейчас застроено.
exercises.prompt: The field where we used to play ball is now all built up.
exercises.why: **мяч → мяч** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (пляж, acc. sg.) выбросился раненый кит.
exercises.prompt: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
exercises.why: **пляж → пляж** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (блюдо, acc. pl.) азиатской кухни часто добавляют глутамат натрия.
exercises.prompt: Asian cuisine is often flavoured with MSG.
exercises.why: **блюдо → блюда** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate. Declines like слово (A. pl. слова). Ending -о → -а.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том покончил с собой на ___ (своё тридцатилетие, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom killed himself on his thirtieth birthday.
exercises.why: **тридцатилетие → тридцатилетие** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → своё** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with тридцатилетие). Declines like мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я в ___ (эти джинсы, acc. pl. — word has no singular) уже не влезаю.
exercises.prompt: I don't fit in these jeans anymore.
exercises.why: **джинсы → джинсы** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun: it has no singular in this meaning. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **этот → эти** (acc. pl., agreeing with джинсы). «этот» has its own declension (not the regular adjective pattern). Its forms (pl.): эти · этих · этим · эти (inan.) / этих (anim.) · этими · этих.  Declension (plural only): джинсы · джинсов · джинсам · джинсы · джинсами · джинсах.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том будет иметь право на ___ (условно-досрочное освобождение, acc. sg.) в следующем году.
exercises.prompt: Tom will be eligible for parole next year.
exercises.why: **освобождение → освобождение** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **условно-досрочный → условно-досрочное** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with освобождение). Declines like новый (A. новое). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том был одет в ___ (форма, acc. sg.) уборщика.
exercises.prompt: Tom was wearing a janitor's uniform.
exercises.why: **форма → форму** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Лосось плывёт вверх по течению на ___ (нерест, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Salmon swim upstream to spawn.
exercises.why: **нерест → нерест** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Положи его в ___ (морозилка, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Put it in the freezer.
exercises.why: **морозилка → морозилку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Норико похожа на ___ (своя мать, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Noriko is like her mother.
exercises.why: **мать → мать** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → свою** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with мать). Declines like мой. Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. мать · матери · матери · мать · матерью · матери; pl. матери · матерей · матерям · матерей · матерями · матерях.  «The nouns мать and дочь take -ер- before the ending in all cases except the nom. and the acc. sing.: матерью, дочерью.» — DLI, Lesson 30.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Иранцы очень хорошо играют в ___ (шахматы, acc. pl. — word has no singular).
exercises.prompt: Iranians are very good at chess.
exercises.why: **шахматы → шахматы** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun: it has no singular in this meaning. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): шахматы · шахмат · шахматам · шахматы · шахматами · шахматах.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Несмотря на ___ (занятость, acc. sg.), она пришла меня навестить.
exercises.prompt: Even though she was busy, she came to see me.
exercises.why: **занятость → занятость** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like часть (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том легонько поцеловал Мэри в ___ (щека, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom gave Mary a light kiss on the cheek.
exercises.why: **щека → щёку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. щека · щеки · щеке · щёку · щекой · щеке; pl. щёки · щёк · щекам · щёки · щеками · щеках.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В среднем, на ___ (каждый улей, acc. sg.) пришлось по два пуда мёда.
exercises.prompt: On average, each hive had eighty pounds of honey.
exercises.why: **улей → улей** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -й. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **каждый → каждый** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with улей). Declines like новый (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. улей · улья · улью · улей · ульем · улье; pl. ульи · ульев · ульям · ульи · ульями · ульях.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
